summary: The 'StudentPRAssignHistory' file contains a partial class used in a web application for displaying and managing a student's practical assignment history. It includes a user control that utilizes ASP.NET UI components such as panels and buttons and has a data binding method for loading student data into a grid view.
purpose: The document is designed to manage and display the history of student assignments related to practical activities in an educational context. It allows users to view, print, and interact with this data through a web interface.

actors.name: User
actors.role: Interacts with the UI to view and print details

workflows.name: Display Student Practical Assignment History
steps: Check if the user session is active.
Fetch student assignment data using StudentProfileHistorySearchSections method.
Bind the data to the grid view for display.

business_rules: The method DataBind is responsible for fetching and binding student data whenever it is called, provided the user session is valid.
validations: Check if UserSession is not null before fetching data.
conditions: Data fetch and bind occur only if UserSession is active.
system_behavior: Generates UI components dynamically using ASP.NET UI controls.
Handles user interaction for data management and display.
exceptions: Behavior is not defined if the UserSession is null.
